summary: Frontend-only retest of the iteration_95 fixes (preview only, test_eur_qa@example.com, desktop 1920 and mobile 390). ALL 4 FIXES VERIFIED. (1) Dashboard day change: /api/portfolio/quotes gave AAPL change_abs -2.422 / -0.7787 %, VOLV-B.ST -0.0412 / -0.1459 %, DBK +0.865 / +2.8814 %. /dashboard/aktien Tag column shows -0,78 % / -0,15 % / +2,88 % and TESTIPO '–'. Tagesveränderung is +9,62 € (+0,50 %), which equals 3*-2.422 + 10*-0.0412 + 20*0.865 = 9.622. Top-Bewegungen are sorted correctly. Übersicht 'Heute' and '+9,62 € heute' match. Watchlist cards show EUR price plus German % (308,61 € -0,78 %, DBK +2,88 %). StockDetail AAPL is −2,42 € (-0,78 %) and DBK +0,87 € (+2,88 %), matching the dashboard. VOLV only drifted with the live tick. (2) Handeln: no row has price outside high/low. AAPL is 308,61 within 308,32–311,59, and many XETRA rows show '–'. (3) /dashboard/alarme shows the AAPL alert '≥ 400,00 · Last 308,61 €'. (4) German commas on StockDetail, Handeln, AktienPage and the IPO-Positionen table. Regression passes: StockDetail € only, Marktkapitalisierung 4,50 Bio. €, EPS 7,83 €. InsufficientBuyingPowerAlert for AAPL 10x300 shows 3.000,00 € needed and 1.250,00 € available (blocked client-side, order count unchanged at 7). IPO-Positionen TESTIPO is 4 / 20 € / 80 € / 25 € / +20 € (+25,00 %) / 100 €. OrdersPage uses €. IPO dialog notes are present for Aspen and Bambusa (13,46–15,26 €, original 15–17 USD) and Siyata (6,28 €, original 7 USD). On mobile 390 there is no $ or USD on any depot page (only the intended FX-source notes) and no horizontal overflow. Remaining: minor leftover decimal-point % formatting in components that were not part of the fix.

ui_bugs.issue: Day % uses a decimal point ('-0.78%', '+2.88%'), and the price has no € sign ('308,61')
Target shows '≥ 400,00' without €, while Last shows '308,61 €'

integration_issues.issue: Values are no longer inconsistent, but they come from different sources. AAPL Handeln shows 311,59/308,32 while detail shows 311,74/307,88. DBK Handeln shows '–' while detail shows a valid 30,97/29,96. This is acceptable per the fix, but not identical.

action_items: Optional polish: switch the remaining toFixed(2)% to de-DE in WatchlistWidget.jsx, UnifiedPositionsTable.jsx, OrdersPage.jsx:789, DepotPage.jsx, AnleihenPage.jsx, KPIStatCard.jsx and HeroBanner.jsx
Optional: show € on the alarm target and the WatchlistWidget price
Optional: use the same quote source for Handeln day high/low as StockDetail
critical_code_review_comments: DashboardDataContext priceMap only accepts quotes with currency === 'EUR'. That is correct for EUR-only display, but if the quotes call fails, positions fall back to p.price without change fields, so the day change silently shows '–'. That is acceptable.
Percent formatting helpers are duplicated (fmtDe, formatPct, IpoPositionsTable). Extract a shared formatPctDe util to avoid future regressions like those above.

success_rate.frontend: 100% of requested fixes; 4 low-priority formatting leftovers

seed_data_creation: None. No orders created (the IBP check is blocked client-side and the order count stayed at 7).
